evidence.title: Armenia as a Global AI Hub: The Firebird AI Center in Hrazdan to Place the Country Among the World's Top Five Leader
evidence.publisher: Ministry of High-Tech Industry of the Republic of Armenia
evidence.attribution: Ministry of High-Tech Industry of the Republic of Armenia
evidence.excerpt: The Ministry says its minister and Firebird AI's co-founder visited the new AI center near Hrazdan, reviewed project progress, and described the project as entering its final phase and nearing completion.
